rc-10 · Five steps, your times

Drawn with: admission-route, stopwatchTheme: The morning count (base)

The 10th counted turn. The rating is asked first and the user’s message is held. Good: one short line, then the answer (approved bm-dg-05).

Counted turn 10 · run 0 · Answers · the user’s messageArrival around 1 PM. Documentation by 2 PM, worst 3–4 PM. Bed allocated by 3 PM, sometimes 4, worst 4–5 PM. Ward or ICU confirms ready by 4 PM, worst 5–6 PM. In the bed by 4:30 PM, worst 6:30 PM. This is the ideal situation, sometimes this can stretch to 7–8 PM. Generally we allocate only after we get confirmation that bed is ready or about to get readied.
The three prompts
  1. It happens, but informally
  2. We do call some patients in early
  3. Why would the morning go to discharges?
